default.description: Main window: read-only entity-graph default plus explicit mutation/snapshot grants, SQL persistence, and deep-link receipts. Least privilege — nothing else is granted.

denied.description: Intentionally grants nothing: the denied probe webview must fail closed on every entity-graph command.

mobile-allowed.description: Mobile main webview: the same least-privilege grant set as desktop.

mobile-denied.description: Mobile denied probe: intentionally omits entity-graph authority from the mobile main webview.
